data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabe 2035 is Marbella’s biggest summer party — nine days of flamenco, fairground rides, casetas, and late-night revelry. But the real secret? A boat charter from Puerto Banús lets you escape the crowds by day and return refreshed for the evening fiestas. Our guide covers everything: which boat fits your group, what’s included, how to book, and why June on the Costa del Sol is perfect for a day on the water.

What is Feria San Bernabe 2035?

Feria San Bernabe is Marbella’s annual fair in honour of the town’s patron saint. In 2035, it runs from 9 to 15 June. The fairground near the town centre fills with colourful casetas (tents), live music, traditional dancing, and amusement rides. Daytime is family-friendly; evenings turn into open-air parties until dawn. Many visitors combine fair visits with a boat rental to enjoy Marbella’s coastline and return in time for the night-time fun.

Why rent a boat during Feria San Bernabe?

June in Marbella averages 28°C air temperature and 22–24°C sea temperature — ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and cruising. Renting a boat gives you a private base to explore coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, anchor for lunch, and then head back to Puerto Banús. From the marina, it’s a short taxi ride to the fairground. You avoid the packed beaches and gain a floating lounge with drinks, snacks, and a skipper who knows the best spots.

Our fleet for Feria San Bernabe 2035

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, 10 minutes from the fairground. Here are the top picks for fair week:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5 m, 9 pax) – from €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Includes skipper, drinks, snacks, and IVA.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5 m, 11 pax) – same pricing as Astondoa 40. Spacious cockpit and sun pad.
  • Mangusta 80 (24 m, 12 pax) – from €4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski. Two variants available (white/grey).
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6 m, 12 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp. Flybridge for panoramic views.
  • Ferretti 94 (29 m, 12 pax) – the largest option. Pricing on request. Ideal for VIP groups.

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8 m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4 m, 5 pax) are affordable and nimble. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

How to book your Feria boat rental

Booking is straightforward. Visit our Marbella boat rental homepage to browse the fleet. For real-time availability and custom durations, contact us via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks ahead for Feria week. Popular boats like the Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 often sell out early. Payment is via bank transfer or card; a 50% deposit secures your date, with the balance due 7 days before departure.

Sample itinerary: a day on the water + Feria night

Here’s a typical plan for a group of 10–12:

  • 12:00 – Board at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, stow bags, safety briefing.
  • 12:30 – Cruise east towards Cabopino. Spot La Concha mountain on the starboard side.
  • 13:30 – Anchor at Cala del Faro. Swim, paddle, enjoy the included drinks and snacks.
  • 15:00 – Lunch on board (bring your own or order from a catering service).
  • 17:00 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark.
  • 18:30 – Taxi to the fairground (€12–15). Enjoy casetas, rides, and music until late.

You can adjust the route to visit Estepona or Sotogrande if you prefer a longer cruise. Your skipper will advise based on sea conditions and your preferences.

What to bring and wear

June sun is strong. Bring sunscreen (SPF 50+), a hat, sunglasses, and a light cover-up. Swimwear is essential; pack a towel and a change of clothes for the evening fair. Footwear should be non-marking (no black soles) — deck shoes or flip-flops. If you plan to bring extra food or drinks, use plastic or cans rather than glass. The boat has a cooler and ice. Remember your phone or camera for photos of the coastline and the fair.

Frequently asked questions

When is Feria San Bernabe 2035?

Feria San Bernabe 2035 runs from Saturday 9 June to Friday 15 June 2035. The main fairground is in Marbella town centre, about 10 minutes by taxi from Puerto Banús.

How do I get from Puerto Banús to the Feria?

Puerto Banús is roughly 6 km from the Marbella fairground. A taxi costs around €12–15 and takes 10–15 minutes. Alternatively, you can walk along the promenade (45 minutes) or take a local bus.

What boats are available for Feria San Bernabe?

We offer 16 vessels from 6.4 m to 29 m. Popular choices for groups include the Astondoa 40 (9 pax, from €749/2h), Azimut 39 (11 pax, from €749/2h), and Mangusta 80 (12 pax, from €4,719/4h). All depart from Puerto Banús.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. Our included drinks are non-alcoholic options, beer, wine, and cava. Glass bottles are discouraged for safety.

How far in advance should I book for Feria week?

Feria San Bernabe is one of Marbella’s busiest weeks. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks ahead, especially for popular boats like the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58. Contact us via WhatsApp for last-minute availability.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellations made 7 days or more before departure receive a full refund. Within 7 days, a 50% cancellation fee applies. No-shows are non-refundable. Weather cancellations are handled case by case.

Are there any age restrictions?

Children of all ages are welcome. Life jackets are provided for all sizes. There is no minimum age, but parents are responsible for children’s safety. The skipper’s decisions on safety are final.

Ready to secure your boat for Feria San Bernabe 2035? Browse our full fleet on the Marbella boat rental homepage or message us on WhatsApp to check availability. Whether you want a speedy 2-hour spin or a full-day cruise with a jet ski, we have the right vessel for your group.
